verdict.rationale: Steel's own docs describe CLI-level click/fill/type and CDP/Puppeteer control (steel-gh-1, steel-docs-8), which is standard selector-based automation, not a DOM-understanding 'act on described element' primitive that survives layout/selector changes. Semantic action-taking is delegated to third-party integrations (Claude/OpenAI/Gemini Computer Use, Browser-Use) rather than being a native Steel capability.
